comparison.objective: Dry-fit a repair coupling across an open drain-pipe joint and center it on witness marks.
comparison.physical_skill: Lift a sagging loose pipe into coaxial alignment while sliding a close-clearance coupling over both ends.
comparison.success_condition: Both pipe ends aligned and sufficiently inserted, coupling centered, assembly released and still.
comparison.reason: Tests simultaneous cylindrical alignment and sleeve insertion; there is no screw setting, locknut reaction, or functional-cycle retention.
